identity_notes: Company A is inferred to be Pop Mart from its 2010 founding, Beijing headquarters, listed status, brand retail, IP creation and operation, model figures, and vinyl plush toys.
Company B is inferred to be LEGO from its 1932 founding, Denmark headquarters, and focus on 3D building blocks.
The identities are not printed by name in the ranking tables and must remain labelled as high-confidence inferences.
limitations: Both market reports were commissioned by TOP TOY from Frost & Sullivan and are not fully independent of the applicant. The initial report fee was RMB750,000 and the current report fee was RMB1,000,000.
The documents are draft application materials, not final prospectuses or audited annual reports.
The 2024 table uses RSV while the 2025 table uses GMV, so the year-over-year comparison is directionally useful but not a strict same-basis series.
No company-level 2023 or 2026 H1/YTD market-share table was established.
